transcribed_question:
A) What is the embryological origin of the structure labelled B.
B) Identify the structure labelled D.

marker.description: Green marker labelled 'B' pointing to a vessel in the porta hepatis.

main_question: What is the embryological origin of the structure labelled B?
main_explanation: The structure labelled B is the hepatic artery proper. It is derived from the ventral pancreaticoduodenal artery, which is a branch of the ventral mesenteric artery (which gives rise to the celiac trunk).

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures is labelled D?
supporting_question.explanation: The marker D points to a large vessel draining the right lobe of the liver into the inferior vena cava, which is the right hepatic vein.
